test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Select the correctly spelt word. **
solution: The correct answer is '**Weird**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the correct spelling word is '**Weird**'. • It means 'strange and unusual'. (विचित्र और असामान्‍य; अजीब) • *Example: My little sister acts** weird **sometimes.(*मेरी छोटी बहन कभी-कभी अजीब हरकतें करती है।) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's look at the** correct spelling** of other options: ​ • ***Prepare- make something ready to use(***किसी चीज़ को उपयोग के लिए तैयार करना) • ***Receive- something offered or delivered(***कुछ प्रस्तावित या वितरित किया गया) • ***Cancel- announced the plan or event will not take place(***घोषणा की कि योजना या कार्यक्रम नहीं होगा) 3a:T942, The erroneous part is '**having the trouble**'.
